{{Quote|Chiss fighters. At least twenty of them, coming in from behind.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="SQ" />}}
'''Chiss fighters''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]]. It is grey and built in a curved, flowing design. It is about the size of a shuttle or heavy fighter.<ref name="OF" />
